statement: FMJ reported on 14 January 2026 that Ranger Fire and Security acquired Dorset-based Partnership Fire and Security, with more than 3,000 customers, as its 14th acquisition since February 2024.

buyer: East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust
statement: A local news article of 2 April 2026, written as opinion, says trust board papers report a Notice of Deficiencies and 92 fire safety breaches at William Harvey Hospital, including fire alarm equipment. No contractor is mentioned. The board paper itself was not read.
